import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
answers[8]['unmarked_final_hard_signs']=[]
answers[14]['slots']['1']='ь'
answers[14]['confidence']['1']='low'
answers[14]['pre1918']='no'
answers[88]['slots']['1']='ъ'
answers[88]['confidence']['1']='low'
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for a in answers: f.write(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
checked=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(checked)==len(items)
for it,a in zip(items,checked):
 assert a['item_id']==it['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,it['slots']+1)}
 assert set(a['slots'])==expected
 assert set(a['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(x in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for x in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(x in ['high','low'] for x in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
 assert isinstance(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs'],list)
counts=collections.Counter(v for a in checked for v in a['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order and slot coverage:',len(checked),'items;',sum(counts.values()),'slots')
print('Calls:',{x:counts[x] for x in ['ъ','ь','other','u']})
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in checked))
